search: One finite Cartesian grid; no expansion or post-result rule additions.

rules.volatility: ATR14 = mean(max(high-low,abs(high-prevclose),abs(low-prevclose)),14)/close; RV20 = rolling standard deviation(ddof0) of daily log close returns,20. At signal close, current bar permitted. Vol floors 0.005 and caps 0.15 fixed before results.
rules.entry: (MAfast>MAslow*(1+entry_multiplier*vol)) OR (close>previous breakout closes maximum AND close>MAslow)
rules.adaptive: Entry formula only; no additional trend filter.
rules.trend: Entry formula AND close>MAslow AND MAslow>=MAslow.shift(slope_lookback).
rules.recovery: Trend family plus close>previous 5 closes maximum AND max drawdown-from-trailing-60-close-peak in previous20 bars >= 2*current_vol. This requires only historical pullback and recovery; no future trough labels.
rules.warmup: all used indicators ready, including full relevant slope/recovery windows. adaptive needs max(slow,breakout+1,volwindow+1), trend adds slow+slope, recovery also requires 80 bars.
rules.execution: next tradable quoted bar open after close signal; exit i permits next entry check no earlier than close i+cooldown; peak from buy signal close; fractional all-in/cash; cash return0; no costs; final close mark only.
rules.suspensions: exclude tradestatus0 before indicators, cooldown and fills, as prior study.

selection.primary: Highest full-observed-2018..2023 cumulative return among maximum daily-close drawdown <=30%; if none report none.
selection.unconstrained: Highest full-observed cumulative return, disclosed separately.
selection.ties: lower max drawdown, then lexicographic configuration order
selection.pareto: Non-dominated return/max-drawdown frontier; not out-of-sample evidence.

diagnostics.time_split: For each stated drawdown cap and unconstrained objective, select on 2018..2021 only and hold parameters fixed for 2022..2023, carrying signals/positions across split. Also separately show continuously selected full-training candidates. Both periods were previously observed in original grid: this is observed-interval chronological diagnostic, not blind validation.
diagnostics.regimes: day i uses previous close only: down if prior close<prior MA60 and prior MA60<MA60 20 bars earlier; up if both inequalities reverse. Else neutral.
diagnostics.down_exposure: fraction of historically down-regime days holding at close; never a retrospective trading filter.
diagnostics.up_capture: sum(log(strategy NAV daily ratio)) / sum(log(stock close daily ratio)) over historically up-regime days, only if stock denominator>0. First stock return uses first open.
diagnostics.cost_proxy: buy/sell fill counts and round-trip counts; no fee assumptions or fee optimization.

read_scope: explicit WHITELIST.json and its two listed parquet files
own prior experiment artifacts allowed by continuation
limitations: Observed full training interval selection, no claim of generalization.
Gross qfq ratio observation, not actual corporate-action account or guaranteed fills.
